subject: [PATCH v3 06/12] mm/collapse: drop the collapse_possible() wrapper

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Expressed agreement with keeping the collapse_possible() wrapper for code readability reasons. Acknowledged the patch but did not provide any technical feedback.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the mm/collapse code by removing unnecessary wrappers and improving readability. The first patch in the series, [PATCH v3 06/12], focuses on dropping the collapse_possible() wrapper, which only forwards to collapse_possible_orders(). This change does not introduce any functional changes.
